create_LinearBase: create a base linear layer with input_size, output_size, bias, and optional quantization config
build_ColumnParallelLinear: build a column-parallel linear layer for tensor-parallel distributed matrix multiplication Y=XA+b
build_QKVParallelLinear: build a QKV parallel linear layer for attention query-key-value transformation with tensor-parallel head splitting
build_RowParallelLinear: build a row-parallel linear layer that splits input across GPUs and optionally all-reduces the output
test_adjust_marlin_shard: test the adjust_marlin_shard function to scale shard_size and shard_offset by marlin_tile_size
